title: Reminders
body:
Reminders is a really handy app for keeping track of things you need to do. You can quickly add tasks, set deadlines, and even get notifications so you don’t forget stuff.

It’s simple to use and helps a lot with schoolwork, chores, or daily plans. You can also organise lists, which keeps everything nice and clear 😊

A cool thing is that you can mark things as done, which feels satisfying and keeps you motivated.

Downside is that it’s pretty basic and doesn’t have a lot of extra features

title: Just a request
body:
I didn’t know where to request an app update, i’ve never done it but this time i really really wanted this update i was thinking of. 

The reminders app is amazing, but is it pleaseeee possible to create a button in which you can add the duration of each reminder (like in calendar) and the ability to sort the reminders by duration? That way i can for example check off the list by shortest task to longest task (or other way around)
An option would also be that due to adding task duration,  adding the deadline would then also create a better overview in calendar, but that’s sidenote. Main point is truly the essence of being able to have a list sorted by duration to enhance effectivity in getting things done

Currently it wastes too much effort and time to sort every task myself. I hope this reaches the right apple service well. 

Thanks 🤍

title: Perfect for my brain!
body:
This app by apple is very perfect. On point! 
As a uni student I use this app always as my planner (all the time) for homework, for shopping lists, reading books (which page I was), exams, sport and so much more. 
Why you need to choose this one? Because you have a lot of options, you can repeat a reminder (weekly,daily,…) you can organise the reminders, set priorities or tags, add note or photos, share/link them,… plus the customisation and the different options of viewing reminders = perfect.
